message.text: Webhook delivery workers use an in-process Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`) with worker goroutines. They do not consume from NATS or RabbitMQ. I am confirming this finding.
The webhook delivery workers do not consume from NATS or RabbitMQ. They use an in-process buffered channel with four goroutine workers. PostAsync enqueues messages to this channel.

r04.
Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used, and no broker queue is declared. Webhook workers consume an in-process buffered channel `asyncPostQueue` (`make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`). `init` starts four goroutines that `Post` each payload; `PostAsync` enqueues or drops if the channel is full.
